## History

God is introduced to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs her to say her prayers for the first time. During her initial prayer, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) addresses God in an unusual and formal manner, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to commit to providing her with religious education. God is later the central focus of the Sunday school service that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends alone at church.
